title: Velocity before collision
description: Essential: The answer must correctly state the speed of block C just before impact, derived from the work-energy theorem considering friction.

title: Collision energy loss
description: Essential: The answer must correctly calculate the mechanical energy lost in the perfectly inelastic collision between B and C.

title: Work against friction
description: Essential: The answer must correctly state the work done by friction on the combined block (B+C) before skateboard A moves.

title: Apply work-energy theorem
description: Important: The solution should apply the work-energy theorem to find the pre-collision velocity, accounting for friction over distance s0.

title: Apply momentum conservation
description: Important: The solution must use conservation of momentum for the short-duration, perfectly inelastic collision between B and C.

title: Force balance for spring
description: Important: The solution should set up the force equilibrium (spring force + friction on blocks = max static friction from ground) to find spring compression.

title: Sign error in work-energy
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the work done by friction is incorrectly signed in the work-energy equation for block C's slide.

title: Forgetting combined mass
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the solution uses mass m instead of 2m for the post-collision block when calculating forces, energy, or work.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Award credit if the final answers are presented with correct units or dimensional analysis is shown.
